## Pre-fire identity gate (run on the firing seat; paste output here BEFORE firing)

```bash

# G1 exact 40-char lowercase hex, never trimmed
[[ "$CANDIDATE_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] && echo "G1 ok"

# G2 this seat's gateway must actually BE on the candidate
openclaw --version
openclaw version --json | jq -r '.build.sha'      # must equal $CANDIDATE_SHA
git -C ~/flesh_beast_tmp/openclaw rev-parse HEAD   # must equal $CANDIDATE_SHA

# G3 the candidate must carry the feature under test
gh api repos/karmaterminal/openclaw/contents/<FEATURE_SOURCE_PATH>?ref="$CANDIDATE_SHA" \
  --jq '.content' | base64 -d | grep -c '<FEATURE_MARKER>'   # want > 0

# G4 seat readiness (public-safe: env presence booleans only)
OPENCLAW_CANDIDATE_SHA="$CANDIDATE_SHA" \
OPENCLAW_SEAT_NAME=<SEAT> \
OPENCLAW_SESSION_KEY=<SESSION_KEY> \
  node tools/k6-proofs/scripts/seat-readiness-preflight.mjs --json \

# G5 docs authority frozen for this round

```

```bash

The default failure scope is **all live rows on the affected seat**. Stop live rows on this seat for candidate/runtime mismatch, unavailable gateway, disabled continuation, missing required credentials, or failed redaction boundary. Static validators and isolated fixtures may continue.

1. Run the committed automation first.

# 75 is exactly that condition, detected by ownership rather than by report.
command -v flock >/dev/null &&
K6_PROOF_GUARD_VARS="$(OPENCLAW_CANDIDATE_SHA=<FINAL_CANDIDATE_SHA> \
  OPENCLAW_SESSION_KEY=<SESSION_KEY> \
  node tools/k6-proofs/scripts/live-run-guard.mjs \
    --manifest tools/k6-proofs/manifests/r-cd-1.json --shell --require-lock)" &&
eval "$K6_PROOF_GUARD_VARS" &&
[ "${K6_PROOF_LOCK_REQUIRED:-0}" = "1" ] &&
[ -n "${K6_PROOF_LOCK_PATH:-}" ] &&
[ -n "${K6_PROOF_SESSION_LOCK_PATH:-}" ] &&

OPENCLAW_SEAT_NAME=<SEAT> \
OPENCLAW_SESSION_KEY=<SESSION_KEY> \
OPENCLAW_CREATE_DISPOSABLE_SESSION=true \
OPENCLAW_CREATE_DISPOSABLE_SESSIONS=true \
flock --nonblock --conflict-exit-code 75 "$K6_PROOF_SESSION_LOCK_PATH" \
  flock --nonblock --conflict-exit-code 75 "$K6_PROOF_LOCK_PATH" \
    ./scripts/run-proofs.sh --live R-CD-1 <FINAL_CANDIDATE_SHA>
```
